npcs.name: 钓鱼的爷爷
npcs.role: an old man who fishes at 后海 every night and morning
npcs.character: Quiet, patient, speaks in a low voice so as not to scare the fish. Sees everything that happens by the water at night.
knows: A white fox with many tails ran along the lake last night, towards 景山
The fish bite best at dawn

explains.狐狸: 像小狗，住在山里，尾巴很大。

npcs.name: 划船的师傅
npcs.role: the man who rents out boats on 后海
knows: The lakes 前海, 后海 and 西海 are called 什刹海
In winter the lake freezes and people skate

explains.后海: 北京的一个湖，在鼓楼西边。

npcs.name: 游客
npcs.role: a young woman from Xi'an taking a walk by the lake
knows: The lane 烟袋斜街 goes to 鼓楼

npcs.name: 诗社的姑娘
npcs.role: a young woman of a poetry club that meets by the lake near 恭王府
npcs.character: Bright, teasing, loves a good second line.
knows: 恭王府 is said to be the garden of 《红楼梦》

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 这儿是后海。你看，水很多！
nodes.translate: This is 后海. Look — so much water!
nodes.why: 什刹海 is three lakes in a row — 前海, 后海, 西海 — the old city's playground: boats in summer, skating in winter.

nodes.say: 你好。小声一点，我在钓鱼。

answers.en: What did you see at night?
Excuse me, have you heard anything?

nodes.translate: Hello. Quietly — I'm fishing.
nodes.why: He fishes at night and at dawn — ask what he has seen.

nodes.say: 昨天晚上，我看见一只白狐狸，有九个尾巴！
nodes.translate: Last night I saw a white fox — with nine tails!
nodes.why: A key line 📌: 白 is white; 只 is the measure word for animals. Nine tails — that is no ordinary fox.

nodes.say: 九个尾巴的狐狸！它去景山了。
nodes.translate: A fox with nine tails! It went to 景山.

nodes.say: 好，我还要钓鱼。再见！
nodes.translate: Right, back to my fishing. Bye!

words.explain: 在水边用一根长长的东西拿鱼。

nodes.say: 我在钓鱼。
nodes.translate: I'm fishing.

words.explain: 在水边用一根长长的东西拿鱼。

nodes.say: 你好！今天没有船了，明天来坐船吧！
nodes.translate: Hello! No boats left today — come for a boat tomorrow!

nodes.say: 你好！这儿很好看！
nodes.translate: Hello! Isn't it lovely here!

nodes.say: 我没有鱼饵了。你能帮我买吗？
nodes.translate: I've run out of bait. Could you buy me some?

words.explain: 鱼喜欢吃的小东西，钓鱼用。

nodes.say: 鱼饵！谢谢你！今天有鱼了！
nodes.translate: Bait! Thank you! Fish tonight!

nodes.say: 坐船吗？三十块。
nodes.translate: A boat? Thirty yuan.

nodes.say: 好！你玩吧！
nodes.translate: Off you go — enjoy it!
nodes.why: An hour on the water between the willows. (The ride itself is imagined — the stamp is real.)

nodes.say: 好，明天来。
nodes.translate: All right, come tomorrow.

nodes.say: 今天是端午节。你看，水上有龙舟！
nodes.translate: It's the Dragon Boat Festival. Look — dragon boats on the water!

nodes.say: 来，吃一个粽子。粽子很好吃！
nodes.translate: Here, have a zongzi. They’re delicious!
nodes.why: 端午 remembers the poet 屈原: people raced boats to find him in the river and threw rice in for the fish.

words.explain: 很长的船，前面像一个龙头。
端午节吃的东西，里面有米。

nodes.say: 来，坐这儿钓鱼。别说话……
nodes.translate: Come, sit here, we’ll fish together. Slowly, no talking…

nodes.say: ……鱼来了！拉！拉！
nodes.translate: …A fish! Pull, quick!

nodes.say: 好！一条小鱼。钓鱼很好玩儿吧？
nodes.translate: Good! A little fish. Fishing is fun, isn’t it?

nodes.say: 我们是一个诗社。你来说下一个：“天上一个月亮，”
nodes.simpler: “天上一个月亮，”下一个是什么？
nodes.translate: We’re a poetry club. You give the next line: “One moon in the sky,”
nodes.why: Homage to 曹雪芹’s 《红楼梦》 (Dream of the Red Chamber): the young people of the Grand View Garden founded the 海棠诗社. 恭王府 by 后海 is said to be the model for the garden. The second line answers the first, word for word.

nodes.say: 好！再来：“今天下大雨，”
nodes.translate: Good! Again: “Today heavy rain falls,”

nodes.say: 你是我们诗社的朋友了！月亮也高兴！
nodes.translate: You’re a friend of our poetry club now!

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 银锭观山。
nodes.translate: 银锭观山 — the hills seen from 银锭桥.
nodes.why: A sign by the bridge. 观 is to look at; 山 hills. This view is one of the old city's famous sights.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 在桥上往前看，你能看见山吗？
nodes.translate: Look ahead from the bridge — can you see the hills?

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 对！很多很多年前的人，也站在这个桥上，看这些山。
nodes.translate: Yes! People many, many years ago stood on this bridge too and looked at these same hills.

words.explain: 很高很高的地方，上面有树。

nodes.say: 你还在找狐狸吗？

answers.en: Yes, I'm looking for the fox.

nodes.translate: Still looking for the fox?

nodes.say: 狐狸往南边跑了，过了三个湖，去北海了，白塔那边。
nodes.translate: The fox ran south, past the three lakes, to 北海 — over by the White Pagoda.
nodes.why: A key line 📌: 往南边 towards the south; 过了 past; 湖 lakes. The 白塔 is on the island in 北海.

nodes.say: 这本书给你。书里有三个湖，也有白塔。
nodes.translate: Here's a book for you. It has the three lakes in it, and the White Pagoda too.
nodes.why: He gives you 《什刹海》 — it is on your 书架 and in 收藏 → 书.

nodes.say: 你好！我想去看白塔。白塔在哪儿？你知道吗？

answers.en: It's on the little island in Beihai.

nodes.translate: Hi! I want to go and see the White Pagoda. Where is it? Do you know?
nodes.why: It's in 《什刹海》, page 5: 北海的湖里有一个小岛，岛上有一个白塔.

nodes.say: 北海的小岛上！坐车去，还是坐船去？

answers.en: Take a boat from the north side of Beihai.

nodes.translate: On the little island in 北海! Do you go by car, or by boat?
nodes.why: Page 6 of the book: you take a boat from the north side of 北海.

nodes.say: 好，我也坐船去岛上看看。谢谢你！
nodes.translate: Great — I'll take a boat to the island too. Thank you!

words.explain: 在水上走的，人坐在里面。

nodes.say: 你回来了！你去哪儿了？
nodes.translate: You're back! Where have you been?

nodes.say: 你看见狐狸了吗？狐狸怕什么？

answers.en: The fox is afraid of cats.
Everyone is afraid of the tiger.
The fox is afraid of water.

nodes.translate: Did you see the fox? What is a fox afraid of?
nodes.why: In the story 《狐假虎威》 everyone is afraid of the tiger — so you need one.

nodes.say: 老虎！我有一个小老虎，它会叫！送给你吧！
nodes.translate: A tiger! I've got a little tiger — it roars! You can have it!
nodes.why: 小明 gives you his toy tiger. Squeeze it and it roars.

steps.now: 兔儿爷 smells a spirit by the water. Walk west from the 鼓楼 square along 烟袋斜街 to 后海 — or ride line 8 one stop to 什刹海.
steps.past: Followed 兔儿爷's nose to the water at 后海.

steps.now: Stand on 银锭桥, the little bridge between 后海 and 前海, and read the sign 银锭观山 beside it.
steps.past: Stood on 银锭桥 and looked west, the way people have for hundreds of years.

steps.now: Ask the old man fishing by the lake what he saw last night.
steps.past: The old fisherman told me what he saw on the lake last night.

steps.now: Ask the old man fishing where to look next — he knows every corner of the lakes.
steps.past: The fisherman gave me 《什刹海》, a little book about the three lakes.

steps.now: In 恭王府's garden by 后海, a girl from the poetry club wants to see the 白塔 too. 《什刹海》 page 5 tells you where it stands.
steps.past: Told the poetry club girl where the 白塔 stands: on the island in 北海.

steps.now: Go to 北海's north shore — line 6 to 北海北, or walk.
steps.past: Came to the north shore of 北海.

steps.now: Take the boat from the pier to the island and go up to the 白塔. Someone will phone you.
steps.past: Crossed to the island and took a photo of the 白塔 for 王阿姨.

steps.now: On 景山, the woman doing 太极 asks which of the five pavilions is the highest. Read the pavilion signs along the ridge.
steps.past: Read the five pavilion signs on 景山 and found the highest, 万春亭.

steps.now: Climb 景山 from its north gate to the highest pavilion, 万春亭 — the old man who sings there sees everything.
steps.past: Climbed 景山 to the pavilion, where someone sees everything.

steps.now: Talk to the old singer on 万春亭 again — he knows a story about foxes.
steps.past: The singer gave me 《狐假虎威》, the fox who borrowed a tiger's power.

steps.now: 《狐假虎威》 page 4: the fox walks in front, the tiger behind. You need a tiger! 小明 on 南锣鼓巷 has a toy one that roars (he is at school 8:00–16:00; line 6 from 北海北 to 南锣鼓巷 is one stop).
steps.past: Borrowed 小明's roaring toy tiger — well, he gave it to me.

steps.now: “故宫西北角附近” — near the north-west corner of the palace: the corner tower 角楼, down the south side of 景山. Go after dark; the bench on 景山 is a good place to wait.
steps.past: Waited for dark by the corner tower and met the fox with nine tails.

quests.title: Bait for the fisherman
quests.blurb: The old fisherman on 后海 has run out of bait and cannot leave his spot.
quests.lead: The old fisherman at 后海 is staring at an empty tin.

steps.now: The fisherman has run out of bait 鱼饵. The corner shop 小卖部 on 南锣鼓巷 sells it.
steps.past: Bought bait for the fisherman at the corner shop.

steps.now: Bring the bait to the fisherman at 后海.

quests.title: A boat on the lake
quests.blurb: The boatman on 后海 rows people across the lake, and the view from the water is the best in town.
quests.lead: A boatman on 后海 calls out to people walking by.

steps.now: Take a boat out on 后海 (30 元) — ask the boatman.
steps.past: Took a boat out on 后海.

quests.title: Fishing on 后海
quests.blurb: The fisherman likes company, as long as you are quiet and patient.
quests.lead: The fisherman at 后海 has a spare stool.

steps.now: Once he has his bait, the old fisherman on 后海 asks you to sit with him.
steps.past: Sat and fished with the old man on 后海.

quests.title: 《红楼梦》 — the poetry club
quests.blurb: A poetry club meets by the lake, like the girls' club in 《红楼梦》, and answers line with line.
quests.lead: Young women by the lake at 后海 are reading poems aloud.

steps.now: A poetry club meets by the lake on 后海. Pick the line that answers theirs.
steps.past: Answered a line at the poetry club by the lake.

items.name: 玩具老虎
items.en: 小明's toy tiger — squeeze it and it roars

title.en: Chapter two · Water and the hill
Chapter two · Water and the hill

steps.en: Water, water everywhere — 后海, and 前海 beyond the little bridge. Somewhere out here a fox with nine tails is playing tricks.
Far past the water: the Western Hills. On a clear day, this is the view the old city loved.
And the fisherman — he was out here all night. Let's ask him.

facts.zh: 什刹海有三个湖：前海、后海、西海。
facts.en: Shichahai is three lakes in a row, more than 700 years old.
facts.how: Read the sign by the lake.

facts.zh: 在银锭桥上，可以看到西边的山。
facts.en: From 银锭桥 you can see the Western Hills — one of old Beijing's eight little views.
facts.how: Read the sign on 银锭桥.

facts.en: In winter the lakes freeze and everyone goes skating.

facts.zh: 恭王府在后海边上，有一个很大的花园。
facts.en: It stands by 后海, with a large garden.

facts.zh: 它的第一个主人是和珅，很有钱。
facts.en: Its first owner was 和珅, one of the richest men in Chinese history.

facts.zh: 花园里有一个“福”字，是皇帝写的。
facts.en: In the garden is a 福 written by the 康熙 emperor; people touch it for luck.
facts.how: Talk to the people in the garden.
